title: The Three Musketeers
author: Alexandre Dumas · Auguste Maquet
description: D’Artagnan joins three musketeers in a world of loyalty, intrigue and daring.
rights: Source edition: public domain in the United States. Listed creative contributors screened for India, UK and EU; original licence retained.
editionCredits: John P. Roberts III, Roger Labbe, Scott David Gray, Sue Asscher, Anita Martin, David Muller and David Widger
longDescription: Movement, unfamiliar places and difficult choices carry the reading experience forward. Alongside the excitement, the story asks what loyalty, resourcefulness and courage look like under pressure. Its historical setting also reflects the assumptions of its period, which modern readers may wish to consider critically.
